observations: Photo 0 shows a yard of many blue plastic drums standing on bare ground.
The drums in front are open-top barrels with loose blue lids resting on them, roughly the large drum size used for water storage.
No clamp rings or bolt rings are visible on the front drums; lids look like plain push-on covers.
Some drums in the back are closed-top with bungs; a few white containers sit on top at the back.
Surfaces look used: scuffs and dirt marks, no labels showing previous contents, no capacity marking legible.
No steel drums are visible despite the seller's words mentioning steel.
Watermark text 'SUNNY EBERE GENUINE' across the photo, so this is a dealer's stock photo, not one specific drum.
No brand or model is printed or legible on any drum.

identity.kind: blue plastic open top drum with lid, water storage barrel

claims.claim: Container drums, water storage drums, plastic barrel
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows many blue plastic barrels with lids, the common water storage drum.
Only a few white containers are partly visible at the back of photo 0; no kegs are shown clearly.
No steel drum appears in photo 0.

risks.risk: Previous contents may be chemicals or oil, making the drum unsafe for drinking water
risks.proof: A photo looking into the drum interior with a torch, plus a photo of any original label or residue
risks.if_unproven: as a used drum fit only for non-potable storage

risks.risk: Cracks, holes or a warped lid that does not seal
risks.proof: A clip of the drum filled with water standing for a few minutes, and the lid pressed on and lifted
risks.if_unproven: as a used drum with an unsealed lid

risks.risk: Capacity unknown; the drum may be smaller than the common large size
risks.proof: A photo of the drum beside a measuring tape showing its height, or the capacity moulded on the base
risks.if_unproven: as the smaller common drum size

risks.risk: Quantity and which drum is sold is unclear, the photo is a dealer's yard shot
risks.proof: A photo of the exact drum or drums being sold with a handwritten note of today's date

proof_requests: A photo of the exact drum being sold with a handwritten note of today's date and the quantity on offer
A photo of the drum interior with a torch, and any label showing what it held before
A photo of the base or side showing the moulded capacity, or the drum beside a measuring tape
A clip of the drum filled with water with the lid on, showing no leak
response.reason: The item is plainly a used blue plastic open-top water storage drum with lid, identified by type, so it can be priced per drum at worst case as used, non-potable and the smaller common size. Previous contents, leaks and quantity stay as conditions until proven.
